verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              इत्युक्तवति भीष्मे तु तूष्णींभूते युधिष्ठिरः । पप्रच्छावसथं गत्वा भ्रातॄन् विदुरपञ्चमान् ॥१॥
verses.english: Saunaka said is that illustrious god, viz., the powerful Narayana, who is a master of the Vedas and their branches, at once the doer and the enjoyer of sacrifices?

verses.sanskrit: धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च लोकवृत्तिः समाहिता । तेषां गरीयान् कतमो मध्यमः को लघुश्च कः ॥२॥
verses.english: The great Meru, that mountain of gold, gave him heaps of that precious metal. The divine Kubera carried on shoulders by men, that lord of Yakshas and Rakshasas, gave him wealth enough for perforining the necessary works of religion, profit, and pleasure. Horses, cars, elephants, and men, by millions.

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चात्मा निधातव्यस्त्रिवर्गविजयाय वै । संहृष्टा नैष्ठिकं वाक्यं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हथ ॥३॥
ततोऽर्थगतितत्त्वज्ञः प्रथमं प्रतिभानवान् । जगाद विदुरो वाक्यं धर्मशास्त्रमनुस्मरन् ॥४॥
verses.english: Having thought thus, the mouse, well-read in the science of Profit and well-acquainted with times when war should be declared and peace made, gently spoke to the cat, saying,

verses.sanskrit: विदुर उवाच । बाहुश्रुत्यं तपस्त्यागः श्रद्धा यज्ञक्रिया क्षमा । भावशुद्धिर्दया सत्यं संयमश्चात्मसम्पदः ॥५॥
एतदेवाभिपद्यस्व मा तेऽभूच्चलितं मनः । एतन्मूलौ हि धर्मार्थावेतदेकपदं हि मे ॥६॥
धर्मेणैवर्षयस्तीर्णा धर्मे लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । धर्मेण देवा ववृधुर्धर्मे चार्थः समाहितः ॥७॥
धर्मो राजन् गुणः श्रेष्ठो मध्यमो ह्यर्थ उच्यते । कामो यवीयानिति च प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥८॥
तस्माद्धर्मप्रधानेन भवितव्यं यतात्मना । तथा च सर्वभूतेषु वर्तितव्यं यथात्मनि ॥९॥

वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              समाप्तवचने तस्मिन्नर्थशास्त्रविशारदः । पार्थो धर्मार्थतत्त्वज्ञो जगौ वाक्यं प्रचोदितः ॥१०॥
अर्जुन उवाच । कर्मभूमिरियं राजन्निह वार्ता प्रशस्यते । कृषिर्वाणिज्यगोरक्षं शिल्पानि विविधानि च ॥११॥
verses.english: Then, again, Brahman, and Rudra, the powerful Sakra the killer of Vala, the Sun, the Lord of the stars, the Wind-god, the god of fire, the god of the Waters, Infinite Space, the Universe too and the rest of the dwellers of heaven,-these, it seems do not know the way of securing an annihilation of conscious existence that is encompassed by one's own efforts.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थ इत्येव सर्वेषां कर्मणामव्यतिक्रमः । न ह्यृतेऽर्थेन वर्तेत धर्मकामाविति श्रुतिः ॥१२॥
विषयैरर्थवान् धर्ममाराधयितुमुत्तमम् । कामं च चरितुं शक्तो दुष्प्रापमकृतात्मभिः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Hence, perhaps, they have not followed the path which is certain, indestructible, and immutable. Hence, perhaps turning away from that path, they have adopted the Religion of Action which leads to conscious existence that is measured by time.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थस्यावयवावेतौ धर्मकामाविति श्रुतिः । अर्थसिद्ध्या विनिर्वृत्तावुभावेतौ भविष्यतः ॥१४॥
verses.english: This, indeed, is one great defeat of those who are wedded to acts, for all their rewards are for the time being. This doubt, O twiceborn one, exists in my heart like a dagger! Tear it out by recounting to me some discourses of old on this subject. Great is my curiosity to listen to you.

verses.sanskrit: तद्गतार्थं हि पुरुषं विशिष्टतरयोनयः । ब्रह्माणमिव भूतानि सततं पर्युपासते ॥१५॥
verses.english: Why, O twice-born one, have the gods been said to be takers of their respective shares of sacrificial offerings presented to them with the help of Mantras in sacrifices of various kinds? Why, again, are the dwellers of heaven worshipped in sacrifices?

verses.sanskrit: जटाजिनधरा दान्ताः पङ्कदिग्धा जितेन्द्रियाः । मुण्डा निस्तन्तवश्चापि वसन्त्यार्थार्थिनः पृथक् ॥१६॥
verses.english: And, O best of twice-born ones to whom do they, who partake of offerings in sacrifices performed to their honour, themselves make offerings when they perform great sacrifices?

verses.sanskrit: काषायवसनाश्चान्ये श्मश्रुला ह्रीनिषेविणः । विद्वांसश्चैव शान्ताश्च मुक्ताः सर्वपरिग्रहैः ॥१७॥
verses.english: The question you have put to me, O king, relates to a deed mystery. No man can quickly answer it who has not practised penances, and who is not acquainted with the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थार्थिनः सन्ति केचिदपरे स्वर्गकाङ्क्षिणः । कुलप्रत्यागमाश्चैके स्वं स्वं धर्ममनुष्ठिताः ॥१८॥
आस्तिका नास्तिकाश्चैव नियताः संयमे परे । अप्रज्ञानं तमोभूतं प्रज्ञानं तु प्रकाशिता ॥१९॥
verses.english: I shall, however, answer you by reciting to you what my preceptor the Island-born Krishna, otherwise called Vyasa, the great Rishi who has divided the Vedas, had said to us on a former occasion when questioned by us.

verses.sanskrit: भृत्यान् भोगैर्द्विषो दण्डैर्यो योजयति सोऽर्थवान् । एतन्मतिमतां श्रेष्ठ मतं मम यथातथम् । अनयोस्तु निबोध त्वं वचनं वाक्यकण्ठयोः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Sumanta, and Jaimini, and Paila of firm vows, and myself as the fourth, and Shuka. as the fifth, were disciples of the illustrious Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततो धर्मार्थकुशलौ माद्रीपुत्रावनन्तरम् । नकुलः सहदेवश्च वाक्यं जगदतुः परम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: We, five in all, endued with self-control and purity of observances, had completely mastered anger and controlled our senses. Our preceptor used to teach us the Vedas having the Mahabharata for their fifth.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलसहदेवावूचतुः । आसीनश्च शयानश्च विचरन्नपि वा स्थितः । अर्थयोगं दृढं कुर्याद्योगैरुच्चावचैरपि ॥२२॥
verses.english: Once on a time, on the breast of that foremost of mountains, viz., the delightful Meru, inhabited by Siddhas and Charanas while we were engaged in reading the Vedas, this very doubt sprang in our minds, that has been given vent to by you to-day. We, therefore, asked our preceptor about it. It heared the answer that our preceptor made. I shall now recount that answer to you, O Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिंस्तु वै विनिर्वृत्ते दुर्लभे परमप्रिये । इह कामानवाप्नोति प्रत्यक्षं नात्र संशयः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Hearing the words that were addressed to him by his disciples, that remover of all sorts of darkness represented by ignorance, viz., the blessed Vyasa the son of Parashara, said these words:मया हि सुमहत् तप्तं तपः परमदारुणम्।

verses.sanskrit: योऽर्थो धर्मेण संयुक्तो धर्मो यश्चार्थसंयुतः । तद्धित्वाऽमृतसंवादं तस्मादेतौ मताविह ॥२४॥
verses.english: I have practised the austerest of penances. You best of men, I am fully conversant with the Past, the Present, and the Future.

verses.sanskrit: अनर्थस्य न कामोऽस्ति तथाऽर्थोऽधर्मिणः कुतः । तस्मादुद्विजते लोको धर्मार्थाद्यो बहिष्कृतः ॥२५॥
verses.english: On account of those penances of mine and of the control under which I kept my senses, while I lived on the shores of the ocean of milk, Narayana became pleased with me. As the result of the great God's gratification, this omniscience about the Past, the Present, and Future that was desired by me, sprang in my inind.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धर्मप्रदानेन साध्योऽर्थः संयतात्मना । विश्वस्तेषु हि भूतेषु कल्पते सर्वमेव हि ॥२६॥
verses.english: Listen now to me as I describe to you, in due order, this great doubt that has perplexed your minds. I have, with the eye of knowledge, seen, all that took place in the beginning of the aeon.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं समाचरेत्पूर्वं ततोऽर्थं धर्मसंयुतम् । ततः कामं चरेत्पश्चात्सिद्धार्थः स हि तत्परम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: He whom both the Sankhyas and the Yogins call by the name of the Supreme Soul, comes to be regarded as the foremost Purusha on account of his own deeds. From Him originate Prakriti that is called the unmanifest or Pradhana by the learned.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              विरेमतुस्तु तद्वाक्यमुक्त्वा तावश्विनोः सुतौ । भीमसेनस्तदा वाक्यमिदं वक्तुं प्रचक्रमे ॥२८॥
verses.english: From the powerful Unmanifest sprang, for the creation of all the worlds, he that is called Aniruddha. That Aniruddha is known among all creatures by the name of the Great Soul.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेन उवाच । नाकामः कामयत्यर्थं नाकामो धर्ममिच्छति । कामः कामयानोऽस्ति तस्मात्कामो विशिष्यते ॥२९॥
verses.english: It is that Aniruddha who, becoming manifest, created the Grandfather Brahman. Aniruddha is known by another name, viz., consciousness, and is gifted with every sort of energy.

verses.sanskrit: कामेन युक्ता ऋषयस्तपस्येव समाहिताः । पलाशफलमूलादा वायुभक्षाः सुसंयताः ॥३०॥
verses.english: Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Fire numbering the fifth—these are the five Great Creatures that have originated from Consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: वेदोपवेदेष्वपरे युक्ताः स्वाध्यायपारगाः । श्राद्धयज्ञक्रियायां च तथा दानप्रतिग्रहे ॥३१॥
verses.english: Having created the Great Creatures he then created their qualities. Combining the Great Creatures, he then created various embodied Beings. Hear me as I describe them to you.

verses.sanskrit: वणिजः कर्षका गोपाः कारवः शिल्पिनस्तथा । देवकर्मकृतश्चैव युक्ताः कामेन कर्मसु ॥३२॥
verses.english: Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, the great Vashistha, and the Self-created Manu,-these should be known as the eight elements. Upon these depend all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रं वा विशन्त्यन्ये नराः कामेन संयुताः । कामो हि विविधाकारः सर्वं कामेन सन्ततम् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Then the Grandfather of all the worlds, viz., Brahman, created, for the success of all creatures, the Vedas with all their branches as also the sacrifices with their limbs. From these eight elements have originated this vast universe.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति नासीन्नाभविष्यद्भूतं कामात्मकात्परम् । एतत्सारं महाराज धर्मार्थावत्र संस्थितौ ॥३४॥
verses.english: Then originated Rudra from the principle of anger. Taking birth, he created ten others like him. These eleven Rudras are called by name of Vikara-Purushas.

verses.sanskrit: नवनीतं यथा दध्नस्तथा कामोऽर्थधर्मतः । श्रेयस्तैलं हि पिण्याकाद्घृतं श्रेय उदश्वितः । श्रेयः पुष्पफलं काष्ठात् कामो धर्मार्थयोर्वरः ॥३५॥
verses.english: The Rudras, the Prakritis, and the several celestial Rishis, having come into existence approached Brahman, with the object of upholding the universe and its work.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पतो मध्विव रसः काम आभ्यां तथा स्मृतः । कामो धर्मार्थयोर्योनिः कामश्चाथ तदात्मकः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Addressing the Grandfather, they said,-We have been created, O holy one, by you, O you of great power. Tell us, O Grandfather, which of us should be vested with what jurisdiction.

verses.sanskrit: नाकामतो ब्राह्मणाः स्वन्नमर्थान्नाकमतो ददति ब्राह्मणेभ्यः । नाकामतो विविधा लोकचेष्टा तस्मात्कामः प्राक् त्रिवर्गस्य दृष्टः ॥३७॥
verses.english: What jurisdictions have been created by you for supervising what particular affairs? Which of us should, gifted with what sort of consciousness, shall take charge of which of these?

verses.sanskrit: सुचारुवेषाभिरलंकृताभिर्मदोत्कटाभिः प्रियदर्शनाभिः । रमस्व योषाभिरुपेत्य कामं कामो हि राजन्परमो भवेन्नः ॥३८॥
verses.english: Do you ordain also to each of us the measure of strength that we are to have for satisfying the duties duties of our our respective jurisdictions.-Thus addressed by them, the great god replied to them in the following way.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिर्ममैषा परिखास्थितस्य माभूद्विचारस्तव धर्मपुत्र । स्यात्संहितं सद्भिरफल्गुसारं ममेति वाक्यं परमानृशंसम् ॥३९॥
verses.english: Brahman said You have done well, ye gods, in speaking to me of this matter. Blessed be you all! I was thinking of this very subject that has drawn your attention.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकामाः सममेव सेव्या यो ह्येकभक्तः स नरो जघन्यः । तयोस्तु दाक्ष्यं प्रवदन्ति मध्यं स उत्तमो योऽभिरतस्त्रिवर्गे ॥४०॥
verses.english: How should the three words be maintained and kept agoing? How should your strength and mine be taken advantage of for the accomplishment of that object.

verses.sanskrit: प्राज्ञः सुहृच्चन्दनसारलिप्तो विचित्रमाल्याभरणैरुपेतः । ततो वचः संग्रहविस्तरेण प्रोक्त्वाथ वीरान् विरराम भीमः ॥४१॥
verses.english: Let all of us, leaving this place, go that unmanifest and foremost of Beings who is the witness of the world, for seeking his protection. He will tell us what is for our behoof.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुहूर्तादथ धर्मराजो वाक्यानि तेषामनुचिन्त्य सम्यक् । उवाच वाचा वितथं स्मयन्वै लब्धश्रुतां धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः ॥४२॥
verses.english: After this, those gods and Rishis, with Brahman, went to the northern shores of the ocean of milk, desirous of doing good to the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              निःसंशयं निश्चितधर्मशास्त्राः सर्वे भवन्तो विदितप्रमाणाः । विज्ञातुकामस्य ममेह वाक्यमुक्तं यद्वै नैष्ठिकं तच्छ्रुतं मे । इदं त्ववश्यं गदतो ममापि वाक्यं निबोधध्वमनन्यभावाः ॥४३॥
verses.english: Arrived there, they began to practise those austere penances that are said by Brahman in the Vedas. Those austerest of penances are known by the name of Mahaniyama.

verses.sanskrit: यो वै न पापे निरतो न पुण्ये नार्थे न धर्मे मनुजो न कामे । विमुक्तदोषः समलोष्टकाञ्चनो विमुच्यते दुःखसुखार्थसिद्धेः ॥४४॥
verses.english: They stood there with mind fixed, immovable as stakes of wood, and with eyes upturned and arms raised upward.

verses.sanskrit: भूतानि जातिस्मरणात्मकानि जराविकारैश्च समन्वितानि । भूयश्च तैस्तैः प्रतिबोधितानि मोक्षं प्रशंसन्ति न तं च विद्मः ॥४५॥
verses.english: For a thousand divine years they were engaged in those severe penances. At the conclusion of that time they heard these sweet words in harmony with the Vedas and their branches.

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहेन युक्तस्य न चास्ति मुक्तिरिति स्वयम्भूर्भगवानुवाच । बुधाश्च निर्वाणपरा भवन्ति तस्मान्न कुर्यात्प्रियमप्रियं च ॥४६॥
verses.english: The Blessed and Holy One said You gods and Rishis having asceticism for wealth with Brahman in your company, honouring you all with welcome, I say to you these words.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्प्रधानं च न कामकारो यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा करोमि । भूतानि सर्वाणि विधिर्नियुङ्क्ते विधिर्बलीयानिति वित्त सर्वे ॥४७॥
verses.english: I know what is in your hearts! Verily, your thoughts are for the behoof of the three worlds. I shall multiply your energy and strength, investing the same with disposition for work.

verses.sanskrit: न कर्मणाऽऽप्नोत्यनवाप्यमर्थे यद्भावि तद्वै भवतीति वित्त । त्रिवर्गहीनोऽपि हि विन्दतेऽर्थं तस्मादहो लोकहिताय गुह्यम् ॥४८॥
verses.english: You gods, well have you practised these penances from desire of worshipping me. You foremost of Beings, enjoy now the excellent fruits of those austerities which you have practised.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततस्तदग्र्यं वचनं मनोनुगं समस्तमाज्ञाय ततो हि हेतुमत् । तदा प्रणेदुश्च जहर्षिरे च ते कुरुप्रवीराय च चक्रिरेऽञ्जलिम् ॥४९॥
verses.english: This Brahman is the Lord of all the words. Gifted with power, he is the Grandfather of all creatures. You also are foremost of gods. Do you all, with concentrated minds, celebrate sacrifices for my glory.

verses.sanskrit: सुचारुवर्णाक्षरचारुभूषितां मनोनुगां निर्धुतवाक्यकण्टकाम् । निशम्य तां पार्थिव पार्थभाषितां गिरं नरेन्द्राः प्रशशंसुरेव ते ॥५०॥
verses.english: In those sacrifices which you will perform, do ye always give me a part of the sacrificial offerings. I shall then, ye lords of creation, assign to each of you your respective spheres and ordain what will be for your behoof.

verses.sanskrit: स चापि तान् धर्मसुतो महामनास्तदा प्रतीतान्प्रशशंस वीर्यवान् । पुनश्च पप्रच्छ सरिद्वरासुतं ततः परं धर्ममहीनचेतसम् ॥५१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said, Hearing these words of that God of gods, all those gods and great Rishis and Brahman became filled with such delight that the hair on their bodies stood erect.
